name: open-in-vscode
description: Adds an "Open in VS Code" button above the prompt that opens the session's workspace in VS Code.

command.title: Editor command
command.description: The command used to open the workspace (code, code-insiders, cursor, ...).

placement.title: Button placement
placement.description: footer: in the prompt footer beside the mode labels; band: above the prompt; both: both places.
